My greatest problem with a film would be, quite precisly, the actors. I'd never be satisfied xD I have a far too heroic picture of all our wonderful heroes to be satisfied with some actor, even if said actor has twenty Oscars in his drawer. There are a few I can picture, but I could for example never find perfect actors for Rand, Moiraine, Egwene, Nynaeve or Siuan. I would not be happy with any choice here whatsoever.

However, I can picture a slightly taller Judie Dench as Sorilea and Meryl Streep as Cadsuane. I think that would do nicely. Sean Ellis is ''the'' actor suited for Thom. Uhmm... Joan Allen as Alviarin, Marcia Cross as Elaida, and Nicole Kidman as Liandrin, perhaps. Those are my basic thoughts on the subject.
